body.name: G_{\mathrm{ABC}}\text{ and }\mathcal J_{\mathrm{ABC}}
body.construction: Set \(H=L=1\) and \(\mathcal V=\{A,B,C\}\). On \(\mathcal W_H\), let \(E_{G_{\mathrm{ABC}}}^{\to}=\{A_{-1}\to C_0\}\) and \(E_{G_{\mathrm{ABC}}}^{\leftrightarrow}=\{A_0\leftrightarrow B_0,B_0\leftrightarrow C_0\}\). Let \(\mathcal J_{\mathrm{ABC}}\) be the singleton containing the controlled direct effect of \(A_{-1}\) on \(C_0\) under the common positive-lag possible-parent intervention convention.
